verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents official REST API client libraries (JavaScript, PHP, Python, Ruby), extension UX guidelines with Storybook integration, and a Marketplace that distributes hundreds of free and paid extensions. These cover the SDK side and a distribution channel, but the evidence shows no scaffolding tool for new extensions and no documented submission or review process for publishing to the Marketplace. Missing for 10: official extension scaffolding/generator tooling, a documented Marketplace submission and review process, independent hands-on corroboration of the developer workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom apps and extensions with official SDKs, scaffolding tooling, and a documented review/distribution path

citations.quote: Official libraries: JavaScript Library, PHP Library, Python Library, Ruby Library
Grow your business with hundreds of free and paid extensions
The WooCommerce repository also includes Storybook integration that allows testing and developing in a WooCommerce-agnostic context.
